changes.title: Ley exit
items: The ley line leaves the speakers' ring in a wide sweep, as round as its other turns, not a tight hook

changes.title: Workshop room
items: The Workshop opens: walk up to the broom bay to fit the parts you've found, one for the tip, the chassis and the exhaust, and see each part's ups and downs and which sets it's in
Fit a whole set at the bay and its spell is yours at once: Rocket for Speed, Hedge for Stealth, Ferry for Ley jump, Joust for Battering, Pile driver for Ground pound
The lathe paints your broom and shapes it: its body and trim colours, its length, thickness, bend and exhaust size
The pegboard shows every part you've found on a map of the world's biomes; tonight's part, if there is one, glows in its corner
Your broom rests on the bay while you're in the house, and the parts you've found hang on the pegboard
A part you find in a wreck now waits for you at the Workshop instead of going straight on your broom
The old broom stand is gone

changes.title: Workshop parts
items: Brooms are built from parts now: a tip, a body and an exhaust, each changing how she flies, with a trade-off
Some nights the find is a crashed broom instead of a trunk: press E at the wreck to take its part, and it goes on her broom if that slot is free
Collect a whole set of parts to cast a broom spell: Rocket for Speed, Hedge for Stealth, Ferry for Ley jump, Joust for Battering, Pile driver for Ground pound
A bare broom no longer takes off again so quickly after landing: the Jet nozzles give that back
